display.purpose: Hero and page titles in Instrument Serif. Tight tracking, ink-wet.

body.purpose: UI copy and leads in Figtree.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono labels, pills, duo captions.

motion.name: ease-fill
motion.purpose: Primary CTA cream wash from the bottom.

motion.name: ease-fold
motion.purpose: Landing Duo open. Killed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink pill. The only filled action.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-cta-ghost{display:inline-flex;min-height:2.75rem;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#141414) 12%,transparent);background:transparent;padding:0.8rem 1.35rem;font:500 0.95rem/1 Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--foreground,#141414);cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms ease,transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)}.ds-cta-ghost:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#141414) 5%,transparent)}.ds-cta-ghost:active{transform:scale(0.98)}.ds-cta-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--foreground,#141414);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.ds-label{margin-bottom:0.45rem;font:500 0.68rem/1.2 IBM Plex Mono,ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:0.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted,#6b645c)}.ds-input{min-height:2.75rem;border-radius:0.85rem;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#141414) 12%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 78%,var(--background,#f4f1ea));padding:0.7rem 0.85rem;font:400 1rem/1.4 Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--foreground,#141414)}.ds-input:focus{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#141414) 35%,transparent);outline-offset:1px}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#141414) 35%,transparent);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Quota pill
components.description: Mono stamp for plan and remaining ZIPs.

components.name: Segment
components.description: Exclusive choice. Ink fill on the selected radio.

components.name: Drop zone
components.description: Dashed sheet for closed or open screens.
components.css: .ds-drop{display:flex;min-height:11.5rem;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:28px;border:2px dashed color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#141414) 38%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,color-mix(in srgb,#fff 78%,var(--background,#f4f1ea)) 70%,transparent);text-align:center;font:500 0.95rem/1.3 Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--foreground,#141414);cursor:pointer}.ds-drop:hover,.ds-drop:focus-within{border-color:var(--foreground,#141414);background:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 78%,var(--background,#f4f1ea))}.ds-drop-count{margin-top:0.5rem;font-size:0.875rem;color:var(--muted,#6b645c)}

components.name: Listbox trigger
components.description: Serif trigger. The only resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-listbox-trigger{display:flex;width:100%;min-height:2.75rem;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:0.75rem;border-radius:0.85rem;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#141414) 12%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,#fff 78%,var(--background,#f4f1ea));padding:0.7rem 0.9rem;font:400 1.05rem/1.1 Instrument Serif,ui-serif,Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--foreground,#141414);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgb(20 20 20 / 0.05);cursor:pointer;text-align:left}.ds-listbox-trigger:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#141414) 28%,transparent)}.ds-listbox-trigger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--foreground,#141414) 35%,transparent);outline-offset:1px}.ds-listbox-caret{width:0.45rem;height:0.45rem;border-right:1.5px solid var(--foreground,#141414);border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--foreground,#141414);transform:translateY(-0.1rem) rotate(45deg)}

narrative.overview:
DuoShot looks like the dossier that lands on the App Store reviewer's desk and holds on the first pass: warm proof cream, near-black ink, captions in uppercase mono. It is a paper instrument, not a SaaS console. Density is operate-mode on `/tool` (scan, act) and persuade-mode on the landing (one claim, then the fold). Personality is impatient with decoration and exact about the fold.

The system has one voice of ink. Action, text, selection, and focus are the same black. Rarity is unused: there is no second brand hue to spend. Warm Proof Cream is the sheet; Lifted Sheet is the slightly brighter field; Warm Caption is the clerk's hand. Harbor gradients exist only inside the demo app screens, never as the product chrome.

Rejected on sight: indigo dashboards, hero metrics, kicker eyebrows, gradient text, glass as decoration, and 3D phone chassis. The Duo silhouette is unframed geometry from real millimetres (outer 84.1×117.8, inner 164.6×117.8), not a generic device mock.
keyCharacteristics: Cream sheet + single ink; no second accent
Instrument Serif for display, Figtree for body, IBM Plex Mono for clerk labels
Pill CTAs; dashed drops; segmented radios
Flat at rest; shadow only when a menu is a layer
Device radii from Duo mm, never a stock phone frame

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: There is no brand blue, no second accent. If it needs to shout, it is Reviewer Ink on cream, or cream on Reviewer Ink.

rules.name: The Sheet Is Not Grey Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces stay warm (cream / lifted sheet). Cool grey panels are off-brand.

rules.name: The Clerk Stamp Rule
rules.body: Pixels, counts, and shelf names wear mono uppercase. Marketing claims wear serif. Do not swap them.

rules.name: The Specs Stay Off Stage Rule
rules.body: Exact pixel strings belong on `/specs` and in tool checks, not in the hero or tool lead.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow means a layer opened or a control is focused — never a card trying to look expensive.

rules.name: The Unframed Fold Rule
rules.body: Preview glass follows Duo millimetres. Do not drop in a generic iPhone frame, notch, or chassis.

dos: Do keep action, text, and focus on Reviewer Ink (#141414) against Warm Proof Cream (#f4f1ea).
Do align closed/open previews on a shared baseline (subgrid), and stack them below 640px.
Do stamp measurements in IBM Plex Mono uppercase.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on the fold and the burger.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand hue, gradient text, or glass panels.
Don't wrap the product in a phone chassis or a generic device frame.
Don't put 1398×2034-class jargon in the hero or the tool lead.
Don't use emoji or “×” as the icon system; name the action (Supprimer).
Don't lift every card with a shadow. Flat until a layer opens.
Don't rebrand DuoShot as Harbor; Harbor is the demo listing only.
